title: The Episode About the Origin of the Khalsa

blocks.text: Now begins the second narrative: how the Khalsa came into being.
The emperor had said that no one had given the Singhs kingship, and that under Nadir Shah and Ahmad Shah they had remained only subjects. (1)
The English wrote down exactly that version: that the Singhs had no sovereignty, no recognized authority, and no king had pardoned or elevated them. (2–3)
If they were only subjects, then — so the argument ran — the land could be snatched away from them. When the English recorded this, the wicked Mughals were pleased. (4)
How could the Turks be anything but pleased, since falsehood about the Singhs was always welcome to them?
